meta.note: 2026 luxury cross-reference. Reliability/ownership from J.D. Power 2025 VDS, Consumer Reports 2025-26, RepairPal-style cost data. Prices CAD MSRP — confirm before purchase.

Lexus.reliabilityNote: J.D. Power 2025 VDS #1 overall (140 PP100, 3rd year running); Consumer Reports top-3 brand.

maintenance.plan: First scheduled service complimentary; Lexus prepaid maintenance optional
maintenance.note: Lowest running costs of the four; ~half the German brands long-term.

BMW.reliabilityNote: J.D. Power 2025 VDS best of the German three (189 PP100); Consumer Reports top-5 in 2025 but long-term repair costs are high.

maintenance.plan: BMW Ultimate Care – 3 yr complimentary scheduled maintenance
maintenance.note: Free for 3 yrs, then expensive; ~$11k over 10 yrs (CR).

Mercedes-Benz.reliabilityNote: J.D. Power 2025 VDS 243 PP100 (above industry avg of 202 = worse); complex tech, costliest upkeep long-term.

maintenance.plan: No brand-wide free maintenance; Star/Prepaid Maintenance is a paid add-on
maintenance.note: Highest running costs of the four; pay-from-day-one servicing.

Audi.reliabilityNote: J.D. Power 2025 VDS 273 PP100 (worst of the four); Consumer Reports dropped Audi 10 spots to #16 in 2026.

maintenance.plan: Audi complimentary scheduled maintenance – 3 yr (new for 2026); Audi Care prepaid optional
maintenance.note: Free for 3 yrs (new for 2026); German-typical costs after.
